title: 第25章 刻意针对第26章 各自安排
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 钦差李文翰端坐在温暖舒适、铺着厚厚毛皮的马车内，透过微微被他掀开的车帘，看到外面寒风中那个单薄身影，嘴角不由得撇了撇，眼中闪过一丝不耐。
“倒是能撑……”他低声自语，随即放下车帘，拿起身旁的书籍、便不再关注。
只要这病秧子不死在队伍里，给他添太大的麻烦，他根本懒得理会。
整个队伍行进的速度并不慢，显然李文翰也想着尽快完成这趟苦差事。
一路北上，地势逐渐变得有些陡峭起伏，官道两旁开始出现一些低矮的丘陵和光秃秃的林地。
残阳西斜，天色渐晚。寒风变得愈发凛冽，刮在脸上如同小刀割肉。
领队的禁军统领，一名面容冷峻、眼神锐利的中年汉子，姓王，官拜校尉，抬头看看天色，又打量一下四周环境，举起手示意队伍停下。
“前方五里处有一背风坡，地势相对平坦，靠近水源，就在那里扎营！”王校尉声音洪亮，带着习惯性的命令口吻。
队伍再次启动，不久后便抵达选定的扎营地点。这是一处位于两座矮山之间的缓坡，背靠北风，坡下不远处有一条尚未完全封冻的小溪，传来潺潺水声。
周围则是片片枯黄的草地和稀疏的林地，视野相对开阔，易守难攻，确实是宿营的好地方。
随着王校尉一声令下，训练有素的禁军士兵立刻行动起来。
士卒卸下物资，搭建营帐，挖掘简易灶坑，收集柴火，取水饮马……一切井然有序，效率极高。
半炷香左右的时间，一座座牛皮营帐如同蘑菇般在坡地上立起，中央区域升起几堆巨大的篝火，橘红色的火焰跳跃着。
驱散着暮色和寒意，也照亮士兵疲惫而警惕的脸庞。饭菜的香气开始在空中弥漫，混合着柴火燃烧的味道。
方云逸被一名士卒引到一处靠近营地边缘、不算起眼的小帐篷前。
这帐篷位置，既远离核心区域的热闹与相对舒适，又恰好处于负责夜间巡逻的士兵休息区域的旁边。
这时，王校尉带着一名身材魁梧、脸上带着一道刀疤的队长走了过来。王校尉目光扫过方云逸，语气平淡，却带着一种刻意的安排。
“方公子，今夜你就宿在此处。你身体孱弱，需要好好休息，就不用参与夜间值守了。”
他顿了顿，指向那名刀疤队长，“这是刘队长，他这一队人马今夜不轮值，就在你旁边帐篷休息。”
说着，他转向刘队长，声音提高了几分，确保周围几名正在忙碌的士兵都能听见。
“刘队长，方公子身份特殊，且体弱多病，晚上你们多照顾着点，务必确保方公子能安心休息，明白吗？”
那“照顾”和“安心”二字，被他咬得略重，带着一种心照不宣的意味。
刘队长心领神会，脸上立刻堆起一个略显夸张的假笑，对着王校尉抱拳躬身。
“统领大人放心！属下明白！”
然后他转向方云逸，那笑容依旧挂在脸上，眼神里却毫无暖意，反而带着一丝戏谑和审视。
“方公子，您就安心歇着！”
“晚上有什么风吹草动，或者觉得冷了、怕了，尽管招呼弟兄们！”
content_en:
Imperial Envoy Li Wenhan was sitting in a warm and comfortable carriage covered with thick furs. Through the slightly opened curtain of the carriage, he saw the thin figure in the cold wind outside. The corners of his mouth curled up involuntarily, and a trace of impatience flashed in his eyes.
"It can hold up..." He whispered to himself, then put down the car curtain, picked up the book next to him, and stopped paying attention.
As long as the sick man didn't die in the team and cause too much trouble for him, he didn't bother to care at all.
The entire team was not moving slowly, and Li Wenhan obviously wanted to complete this hard work as soon as possible.
As we go north, the terrain gradually becomes steeper and undulating, and some low hills and bare woodland begin to appear on both sides of the official road.
The setting sun is setting in the west, and it is getting late. The cold wind became more and more biting, blowing on my face like a knife cutting flesh.
The leader of the Imperial Guards, a middle-aged man with a stern face and sharp eyes, named Wang, was a school captain. He looked up at the sky, then looked at the surrounding environment, and raised his hand to signal the team to stop.
"There is a leeward slope five miles ahead. The terrain is relatively flat and close to the water source. Set up camp there!" Colonel Wang's voice was loud and had a habitual command tone.
The team started up again and soon arrived at the chosen camping spot. This is a gentle slope between two low mountains, backed by the north wind. Not far down the slope is a stream that has not been completely frozen, and the sound of gurgling water can be heard.
Surrounded by patches of withered grass and sparse woodland, the view is relatively wide and easy to defend but difficult to attack. It is indeed a good place to camp.
Following Captain Wang's order, the well-trained Imperial Army soldiers immediately took action.
The soldiers unloaded supplies, set up tents, dug simple stove pits, collected firewood, and fetched water for their horses... everything was in order and very efficient.
In about half a stick of incense, cowhide tents were erected on the slope like mushrooms. Several huge bonfires rose in the central area, with orange-red flames jumping.
Dispelling the dusk and chill, it also illuminates the tired and alert faces of the soldiers. The aroma of the food began to fill the air, mixed with the smell of burning wood.
Fang Yunyi was led by a soldier to a small, inconspicuous tent near the edge of the camp.
The location of this tent is far away from the bustle and relative comfort of the core area, and it is also right next to the rest area for the soldiers responsible for night patrols.
At this time, Lieutenant Wang came over with a burly captain with a scar on his face. Colonel Wang glanced at Fang Yunyi, his tone was calm, but with a deliberate arrangement.
"Master Fang, you will stay here tonight. You are weak and need a good rest, so you don't need to participate in the night watch."
He paused and pointed to Captain Scar, "This is Captain Liu. His team is not on duty tonight and will be resting in the tent next to you."
As he spoke, he turned to Captain Liu and raised his voice a bit to ensure that the soldiers who were busy around him could hear him.
"Captain Liu, Mr. Fang has a special status and is frail and sick. You should take more care of him at night and make sure that Mr. Fang can rest peacefully. Do you understand?"
The words "care" and "peace of mind" were emphasized by him slightly, with a tacit meaning.
Captain Liu understood this and immediately put on a slightly exaggerated fake smile on his face, cupping his fists and bowing to Captain Wang.
"Don't worry, Commander! Your subordinates understand!"
Then he turned to Fang Yunyi, the smile still hanging on his face, but there was no warmth in his eyes, instead there was a hint of teasing and scrutiny.
"Master Fang, just rest in peace!"
"If there is any disturbance at night, or if you feel cold or scared, just call the brothers!"
